notes: Cave threat test: more frequent encounters, especially tier 2/3 in deep caves. Darkness, biome exclusions and local caps remain; extra encounters stay at least 32 blocks from players. 16/11/2026: encounters include the two mineshaft rules (zombie, runner) that were only in spawner.json since 14/11; tools/rebuild-depth-spawns.ps1 regenerates spawner.json from here.

bands.name: surface and entrances
bands.threat: natural tier 1; no artificial cave floor

bands.name: shallow caves
bands.threat: common hostiles plus occasional Rocky Roller/Chort

bands.name: middle caves
bands.threat: common hostiles with tier 2 replacements introduced gradually
bands.resources: regular veins plus occasional deep deposits

bands.name: deep caves
bands.threat: tier 2 population with rare tier 3; commons thin only after replacements arrive

bands.name: abyssal caves
bands.threat: tier 2 and tier 3; Demon Lord is exceptionally rare

environmentRules.darkness: Controlled spawns require complete block darkness through conditions.and.maxlight.
environmentRules.openSpace: Each rule uses at least 20 placement attempts, a vertical distance limit of 16, cave=true, entity collision checks, and local caps.
environmentRules.biomes: Generic cave filler excludes Deep Dark, every Alex's Caves biome, and forge:no_default_monsters biomes. Those locations keep their own authored populations and atmosphere.
environmentRules.localCaps: Each controlled type has a small per-player-area cap to avoid crowding.
environmentRules.deepReplacementSafety: Ordinary deep zombies/skeletons are retained whenever no replacement population is nearby.
